subject.title: TUI: Support Shift+Enter for newline (Enter to send)

question: Should this issue finish as documentation/help for the existing Shift+Enter behavior, or should OpenClaw also own a persistent configurable send/newline keybinding preference?
rationale: Basic multiline input already comes from the upstream editor, while exposing customizable bindings would add a new OpenClaw configuration and compatibility contract.

options.title: Document Existing Behavior
options.body: Add TUI docs and in-product help for Shift+Enter, terminal support, and fallback behavior without adding another OpenClaw setting.

options.title: Add One TUI Preference
options.body: Define and persist a canonical send-key mode, wire it through the editor dependency, and cover fresh and upgraded behavior with focused tests.

recommendation.title: Document Existing Behavior
recommendation.body: Add TUI docs and in-product help for Shift+Enter, terminal support, and fallback behavior without adding another OpenClaw setting.

likelyOwner.reason: The TUI editor and documentation history is concentrated around this person, who also previously articulated this exact remaining decision.
